```{r}
#Rural/Urban 
per_fv_2023 %>%
  crosstab_3way(x=b1q3_perv1,z=b1q11_perv1,y=b4q12_perv1,weight = weight_f,unwt_n = TRUE)

per_fv_2023 %>%
  crosstab(x=b1q3_perv1,y=b4q12_perv1,weight = weight_f,unwt_n = TRUE)

#Gender
per_fv_2023 %>%
  crosstab_3way(x=b4q5_perv1,z=b1q11_perv1,y=b4q12_perv1,weight = weight_f,unwt_n = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#Labour force
sum(per_fv_2023 %>%
      filter(
        age_group %in% c("15-29", "30-49", "50-59") &
          labour_force == "Yes" & b1q11_perv1==1
      ) %>% select(weight_f)) / sum(per_fv_2023 %>%
                                      filter(age_group %in% c("15-29", "30-49", "50-59") & b1q11_perv1==1) %>% select(weight_f))

#Labour force
sum(per_fv_2023 %>%
      filter(
        age_group %in% c("15-29", "30-49", "50-59") &
          labour_force == "Yes" & b1q11_perv1==2
      ) %>% select(weight_f)) / sum(per_fv_2023 %>%
                                      filter(age_group %in% c("15-29", "30-49", "50-59") & b1q11_perv1==2) %>% select(weight_f))
```
